item.description:
Mike Flanagan’s devil-themed film opens March 12, 2027 with Scarlett Johansson trailer

On March 12th, 2027, Mike Flanagan brings his take on the devil to theaters.

Scarlett Johansson faces down evil in the first trailer for The Exorcist: Martyrs.

🎬 Overview

  • Film: Mike Flanagan’s take on the devil
  • Trailer: Features Scarlett Johansson facing evil
  • Release date: March 12, 2027

📍 Venues

  • Estadio Atanasio Girardot, Medellín, CO
  • Teatro Campos Elíseos Antzokia – Sala Teatro, Bilbao, ES
  • Sala Magna at Auditorium de Palma – Complex, Palma, ES
  • Centro de Artes Escénicas y de la Música – CAEM, Salamanca, ES
  • Gran Teatro de Cáceres, Cáceres, ES
